visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a studio set styled like a living room. A male creator with dyed brown hair and glasses, wearing a black sweatshirt, sits on a gray fabric sofa. He gestures emphatically with his hands while speaking to the camera. Behind him is a computer monitor displaying a blue screen and a large Godzilla figure on a shelf. (2) The scene shifts to screen recordings of mobile interfaces showing LINE and Facebook chat logs and profiles. Various screenshots of text conversations and social media pages are displayed as overlays on a dark background to illustrate scam evidence. (3) Returning to the studio, the man picks up a white plastic bag and pulls out two black spray bottles and a pink microfiber cloth. He places them on a small gray table in front of him, pointing at the product labels and looking frustrated. (4) Transition to a brightly lit detailing garage. The man is seen washing a black car, using a green hose to spray water on the windshield. He applies a thick white paste from a container onto the glass with a blue round sponge using circular scrubbing motions. (5) He rinses the glass to show a hydrophobic effect where water sheets off instantly. He holds up a professional 'ATDC' branded cardboard box and demonstrates more products on the car's body. Finally, he returns to the camera to deliver a concluding warning.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy male narrator in a studio setting. A fast-paced electronic beat (approx. 128 BPM) begins immediately. A 'thud' sound is heard as he gestures at a table. (2) Vocal pitch variability is high as he describes screen captures of scams. Short 'whoosh' transition effects punctuate the visual shifts. (3) The narrator's tone becomes more urgent and authoritative. Percussive sounds occur as physical products are handled and placed on a table. The BGM remains consistent in rhythm. (4) The acoustic environment shifts to include the broadband sound of spraying water and rhythmic scrubbing noise during a car cleaning demonstration. Vocal volume increases to compete with the ambient water noise. (5) A clear 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of official logos. The narrator delivers a concluding warning with a strong falling intonation for emphasis, followed by a hard cut fade of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Evidence -> Comparison -> Tutorial -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to warn followers about counterfeit versions of the creator's car care brand (ATDC) being sold on social media. It provides evidence of scams, compares fake packaging with real items, and demonstrates proper product usage to reinforce the brand's value and direct traffic to official sales channels.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator is the owner of the brand being featured and uses the entire video to promote and protect his products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-intensity social media style video with high density of text overlays and rhythmic editing designed for viewer retention and brand protection.
